gold_assessment.reasoning: Chief complaint of cough and cold is not mentioned in any generated fact.

Gold: weight 65 kg. Gen pe-002: patient-reported weight is 65 kg. Same measurement with note that it is patient-reported.
Gold: no sputum production or haemoptysis. Gen hpi-001 includes 'no sputum or hemoptysis'. Same information captured within HPI.
Gold: no epistaxis or sinus pain. Gen hpi-002: constant green nasal discharge, no epistaxis or sinus pain. Negative symptoms are captured.

Gold: no SOB, inspiratory pain, or wheeze. Gen hpi-005/006/007: no SOB or wheeze except with intense exercise; also no chest pain. The generated text introduces exertional wheeze but preserves 'no wheeze' at rest, which partially conflicts with the simple 'no wheeze' in gold. Because the gold statement is broad (no wheeze at all) and the generated one introduces conditional wheeze, this gold fact is not fully correctly represented; thus not cleanly covered.
Gold: no vomiting. Gen hpi-004: initial mild diarrhea resolved; no current vomiting or diarrhea. Denies vomiting, so this is captured.
Gold: eating and drinking are okay. No generated fact addresses adequacy of eating or drinking.
Gold: passing urine is okay. No generated fact addresses voiding status.
Gold: no history of chest problems, recurrent chest infections, or weight loss. No generated fact comments on these historical negatives.
Gold: no increased thirst or urinary frequency. Not mentioned in the generated facts.
Gold: does not check blood sugars or urine at home. Not reflected in generated facts.
Gold: thinks last BP was fine, can't remember when last BP/DM check-up was. Generated facts refer to recent normal blood tests but not this specific self-report; thus omitted.
Gold: impression is viral bronchitis. Generated assessment asm-001 is acute URI likely viral, not specifically viral bronchitis; this is a different diagnosis, so the gold assessment is not covered.
Gold: continue Lemsips but no other paracetamol-containing products. Gen plan-002: continue Lem Zips and avoid additional paracetamol-containing products simultaneously. Same instruction.
Gold: avoid cough syrup but may take at night if unable to sleep. Gen plan-003: use cough syrup only at night if cough disrupts sleep. Same practical guidance.
Gold: explained illness may take 1–2 weeks to settle and cough can persist up to a month. No generated fact states expected duration or course.

Gold: contact clinic if symptoms worsen, fever persists (with thermometer), or coughing up phlegm, blood in sputum, or nose bleeds. Gen plan-001/fu-001: seek review if persistent fever ≥37.5–38°C, worsening cough, productive/purulent sputum, hemoptysis, epistaxis, chest pain, SOB. Thresholds and details added but core follow-up triggers match.
Gold: reminded to book regular diabetes and BP check-up appointments. Gen plan-004/fu-002: reinforce regular diabetes and hypertension follow-up. Same message.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Gold: dry cough 4–5 days, no sputum/hemoptysis (as ROS). Generated adds frequency (~every 20–30 min) and explicitly merges ROS negative findings into HPI. Duration and nature are consistent but additional specific frequency and packaging; best classified as ADDITION rather than a 1:1 support.

Gold notes runny nose but does not specify 'constant' or 'green'. Also ROS says no epistaxis/sinus pain which is repeated here. Color and constancy of discharge are new details, so this is an addition built upon hpi-001 and ros-002.
Gold: feels hot, hasn't measured temperature. Generated: intermittently hot and chilly; no measured fever. Intermittent and feeling chilly are not in gold; overall consistent but more detailed.

Gold: initial diarrhea resolved; ROS: no vomiting. Generated adds that diarrhea was 'mild' and explicitly states no current diarrhea/vomiting. This is more specific but consistent with hpi-005 and ros-004.
Muscle aches is a subset/phrasing of generalized aches and pains; this aligns with gold HPI aches and pains.

Gold: no SOB/inspiratory pain/wheeze. Generated: denies headache, visual changes, chest pain, SOB at rest. Adds several negatives (headache, visual changes, chest pain) not in gold. SOB denial is consistent; the rest are additions.
Gold ROS: 'No ... wheeze' without qualification. Generated: 'wheezing only with intense exercise', which introduces presence of wheeze under some conditions, contradicting the blanket 'no wheeze'.
Gold: type 2 diabetes mellitus. Generated: diabetes. Same condition; gold gives more specificity on type.
Gold: hypertension. Generated: patient has hypertension. Fully supported.
Occasional hay fever is not present anywhere in the gold facts; this is new PMH info.
Gold: metformin. Generated: taking metformin for diabetes. Consistent with gold medication list.
Gold lists lisinopril but no dose. Generated specifies lisinopril 200 mg. The dose is an added detail not present in gold but not contradictory.

Gold: taking 2–3 Lemsips/day which eases symptoms. Generated: Lem Zips 2–3/day for throat soothing. Frequency and self-medication are supported; 'for throat soothing' is a more specific indication, therefore an addition.

Gold provides height and weight only; it does not state whether other vitals or physical exam were or were not documented. 'No vitals or physical exam documented' is new documentation detail, not supported by gold.

Gold assessment: 'Imp: Viral bronchitis.' Generated: 'Acute upper respiratory tract infection, likely viral.' While clinically related, URTI and viral bronchitis are coded differently; this is a different diagnostic label and thus a contradiction with the specific gold impression.
Gold PMH lists T2 DM but does not state 'recent normal blood tests (~3 weeks ago)'. Condition and metformin use are supported, but recent labs are additional information.
Gold PMH lists hypertension but does not mention 'lisinopril 200 mg' in the assessment nor 'BP status unknown'. Dose and BP status are added details beyond gold.

Gold follow-up (fu-001) advises contacting clinic if symptoms worsen, fever persists (checked with thermometer), coughing up phlegm, blood in sputum, or nose bleeds. Generated adds specific temperature thresholds (≥37.5–38°C), productive/purulent sputum, chest pain, SOB. Core idea (monitor temp, follow-up if persistent fever/worsening symptoms/bleeding) is supported but with added specifics, so classified as ADDITION.
Matches gold advice to continue Lemsips (Lem Zips) and avoid other paracetamol-containing products.
Matches gold: avoid cough syrup generally but may use at night if unable to sleep due to cough.
Reinforcing regular diabetes and hypertension follow-up matches the gold reminder for regular diabetes and BP check-ups.
Gold plan does not mention antibiotics. 'No antibiotics at present; consider if bacterial infection suspected' is a new management detail not present in gold.

Same content as plan-001 in follow-up form: adds explicit temp range (≥37.5–38°C), productive/purulent sputum, chest pain, SOB. Gold fu-001 mentions worsening symptoms, persistent fever, phlegm, blood in sputum, nosebleeds without these extra qualifiers. Thus it extends gold follow-up criteria.
Advises ongoing regular diabetes and hypertension follow-up, which matches gold follow-up advice for regular diabetes and BP check-up appointments.
